legacy.name: ever_60dpd_24m
legacy.window: provider loan_age 0 through 24 inclusive; 25 possible integers
legacy.event: numeric delinquency>=2 or RA mapped to 9
legacy.missing: missing/unparseable status is a false event; any loan with a row in window enters label aggregation
legacy.maturity: 2018/2021/2022 no date gate; 2023 uses first payment cutoff
legacy.caveat: Freddie loan_age resets at modification, so provider loan_age window is not always original-calendar window

strict.name: strict_calendar_age0_24_60plus_or_reo
strict.window: calendar_age in [0,24] inclusive; intentionally preserve 25 possible ages as a sensitivity, not call them exactly 24 observations
strict.maturity: original first_payment_date +23 months <= maximum observed monthly_reporting_period in source snapshot
strict.positive: mature and any numeric delinquency>=2 or RA in calendar window; RA is REO acquisition, reported separately and explicitly included in composite
strict.negative: mature, all calendar ages0..24 have valid status, no invalid in-window status, no unlocated record, no conflicting valid status for same loan-month, and no event
strict.unknown: all remaining cases stay missing and excluded from sensitivity evaluation
strict.terminal_states: record zero-balance code frequency/occurrence; do not treat any exit code as automatic negative
strict.scope: selected outcome-identifiable subgroup, potentially selected by outcomes and servicing; cannot recover all-originations risk or unbiased audit benefit

prospective_requirements: development label availability <= freeze date <= claimed queue date
do not reinterpret 2026 model fitting as historical 2018 deployment
source cutoff is not provider release date
fannie_status: existing servicing audit checked raw-age presence or any exit, not the new strict original-calendar contract; not silently upgraded
